audit_title: QuantEngine Phase 171 Independent Audit & Maker Research Findings

findings.summary: Taker fees consume >100% of gross profit on sub-10-point scalps
findings.description: On a 1-contract BTCUSD position with 0.001 multiplier, round-trip taker fees with 18% GST equal 0.0968 USD (96.78 points). A 4.50-point scalp (+0.0045 USD gross) incurs 0.0871 to 0.0968 USD in fees, generating a guaranteed loss (-0.0826 USD net).
findings.mitigation: Implemented core/execution/friction_hurdle_gate.py which automatically rejects any trade setup where fees exceed 40% of target profit.

findings.summary: Passive maker execution cuts exchange friction by 60.0%
findings.description: Under Delta India fee schedule, maker fees are 0.02% base (vs 0.05% taker), yielding an effective round-trip fee of 0.0387 USD (38.71 points). Moving to passive limit orders saves 0.0581 USD per contract and drops breakeven hurdle by 60%.
findings.mitigation: Designed core/execution/maker_execution_model.py and post-only boundary guards.

findings.summary: L2 orderbook queue depth permits 86.2% fill probability in 10s with 2.0 bps adverse selection drag
findings.description: Top-of-book depth on BTCUSD averages 1,312.53 bid contracts and 686.10 ask contracts. A modeled queue position of 100 contracts has expected wait time of 5.0 seconds. Even after 2.0 bps adverse selection penalty (0.0164 USD), maker execution preserves a net +0.0309 USD benefit over taker crossing.
findings.mitigation: Integrated queue dynamics and adverse selection penalty modeling in core/research/queue_dynamics.py.
